# Cascade

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Cascade`](gmeow-Cascade.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Cascade>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/risk`](../../slices/risk.md)

A NAMED chain of causal links — 'Trust Collapse: betrayal dissolves the bond, bond dissolution kills the will to survive.' A social object: the cascade exists as a recognized failure narrative, independent of anything ever occurring. Entered at [`gmeow:cascadeFirstLink`](../properties/gmeow-cascadeFirstLink.md), walked by [`gmeow:linkNext`](../properties/gmeow-linkNext.md), graded by [`gmeow:cascadeSeverity`](../properties/gmeow-cascadeSeverity.md). Acyclic within itself (SHACL); propagation arithmetic is solver work ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).
